copy.html:
With origins dating as far back as 1763, the Spanish La Primitiva is one of the oldest lotteries in the entire world. In fact, the name itself means 'The Primitive One' - a reference to its long history. Spanish La Primitiva is a hugely popular lottery, and it's certainly clear why! With huge prizes up for grabs, you can now buy a Spanish La Primitiva ticket even if you are not a Spanish resident, right here at LottosOnline. So wherever you are, you have the chance to transform your life forever!

The Spanish La Primitiva lottery draw takes place every Monday, Thursday and Saturday in Madrid at 21:30 Central European Time (CET). So select your lucky numbers, buy your ticket and we wish you the best of luck!

How Much Could You Win?

The Spanish La Primitiva lottery has seven prize payout tiers. 55% of overall ticket sales are put back into the prize fund - which means there's plenty of cash to play for!

The jackpot starts a minimum of €3,000,000 and rolls over each week if there is no winner. It sometimes reaches more than €60,000,000 - now that really is a life-changing sum of money! It's time to start dreaming of life as a millionaire!

Playing Spanish La Primitiva Online

Buying a ticket for the Spanish La Primitiva online could not be easier with LottosOnline! Simply set up your free account, and you'll be ready to play and boost your chances of becoming a millionaire!

To buy your official lottery ticket, log in to your LottosOnline account, select Spanish La Primitiva and choose six main numbers from 1 - 49.

Once you have paid for your tickets using your preferred payment method, we will send immediate confirmation of your order via email. Then, our local ticket purchasing agent will buy your official La Primitiva lottery ticket and store it securely until after the draw. You will receive an email including a link to your scanned copy of your official lottery ticket.

How Do I Win the Spanish La Primitiva Lottery?

The Spanish La Primitiva lottery also has a Reintegro feature. A number between 0 - 9 is automatically assigned to your ticket upon purchase. If you correctly match all 6 of the main numbers plus the Reintegro number, then we're talking life changing amounts of money! This is how you win the jackpot. If you don't win any prizes but match the Reintegro, you get €1 back.

During the draw, a 7th number is also drawn - this called the Complementario. If you have correctly picked 5 of the main numbers plus the Complementario number, then you will win the 3rd-tier prize.

You've Won! What Happens Next?

Congratulations! You've won - and now it's time to celebrate!

If you have a winning entry, we will let you know straight away via email. You can also check the latest Spanish La Primitiva results on LottosOnline.

As soon as the winning numbers have been verified your winnings will reflect in your LottosOnline Winnings Balance. From there, you can choose exactly how to use your winnings: either arrange their transfer by our agents to your bank account or convert them into more Account Balance to play again. The decision is yours! For jackpot wins, we will get in touch as soon as results are verified to discuss the next steps for uniting you with your winning ticket.

Fun Facts About Spanish La Primitiva Lottery

Did you know?

  • The Spanish lottery broke all records when it reached €101.7 million after 56 rollovers in October 2015, beating the previous record of €98,440,000! It's only a matter of time before this record is broken once again!
  • A staggering 98% of Spaniards buy a lottery ticket at least once a year!
  • Spanish La Primitiva once turned an active social reformer into a millionaire - at the time he was in Madrid protesting about unemployment! He used his winnings to help continue his efforts
  • The Reintegro ball wasn't included initially. It was introduced in June 1991.
